parameters.query:
WITH artifact AS (
  SELECT
    artifact_id,
    file_name,
    mime_type,
    encode(content_bytes, 'base64') AS content_base64,
    octet_length(content_bytes) AS size_bytes
  FROM resume_artifacts
  WHERE artifact_id = $1
    AND sender_id = $2
)
SELECT
  $1::text AS requested_artifact_id,
  $2::text AS sender_id,
  artifact.artifact_id,
  artifact.file_name,
  artifact.mime_type,
  artifact.content_base64,
  artifact.size_bytes
FROM (SELECT 1) AS request
LEFT JOIN artifact ON TRUE;

WITH request AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS sender_id,
    $2::text AS artifact_id,
    length($3::text) > 0 AS grant_token_present
),
grant_match AS (
  SELECT
    grant_id,
    expires_at,
    revoked_at
  FROM download_grants
  WHERE sender_id = $1
    AND artifact_id = $2
    AND token_hash = digest(
      COALESCE(NULLIF($3::text, ''), 'missing-grant-token'),
      'sha256'
    )
)
SELECT
  request.sender_id,
  request.artifact_id AS pdf_artifact_id,
  request.grant_token_present,
  grant_match.grant_id,
  grant_match.expires_at,
  grant_match.revoked_at,
  CASE
    WHEN NOT request.grant_token_present THEN 'missing'
    WHEN grant_match.grant_id IS NULL THEN 'invalid'
    WHEN grant_match.revoked_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'revoked'
    WHEN grant_match.expires_at <= now() THEN 'expired'
    ELSE 'valid'
  END AS grant_status,
  (
    grant_match.grant_id IS NOT NULL
    AND grant_match.revoked_at IS NULL
    AND grant_match.expires_at > now()
  ) AS grant_valid
FROM request
LEFT JOIN grant_match ON TRUE;
